annotation.emotional_arc: A quiet, reflective observation of change and shared exhaustion in the city.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The shared journey of life, relationship, or struggle that became too exhausting to continue.
acceptable_visual_variants: A long, empty city street stretching into the distance under a dim sky, symbolizing an exhausting journey.
An abstract path that transitions from structured streets to fragmented lines, representing the decision to stop.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Physical streets on which a person walked until they were physically tired and wanted to stop.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might literally depict a person sitting down on a concrete city sidewalk, missing the deeper emotional exhaustion of a life path or relationship ending.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: enduring a prolonged life struggle or relationship

metaphor_spans.source_span_original:
रास्ते जिन पर चलते-चलते
थक कर तुमने कहा था - "अब बस!"
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation:
streets on which, walking on and on,
You tiredly said - "Enough now!"
metaphor_spans.source_term:
रास्ते जिन पर चलते-चलते
थक कर तुमने कहा था - "अब बस!"
metaphor_spans.tenor: Enduring a long, exhausting life journey, relationship, or shared struggle until reaching a breaking point.
metaphor_spans.vehicle: Walking continuously on physical city streets until physical exhaustion sets in.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a long, winding path or street fading into a hazy city background, with a single pair of footprints stopping abruptly, or a symbolic fork in the road, to capture the emotional weight of stopping.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The rhythmic and continuous aspect of the reduplicated participle 'चलते-चलते' (chal-te chal-te) is partially flattened into 'walking on and on', which loses the natural, repetitive cadence of the Hindi grammatical structure.

The colloquial, conversational weight of the phrase 'अब बस!' (ab bas!) is rendered as 'Enough now!', which slightly loses the idiomatic, immediate, and exhausted tone of the original Hindi exclamation.

annotation.theme: The passage of time and change in an urban landscape linked to personal memories of shared exhaustion.

consistency_review_findings.issue: The translation_quality is marked as 'faithful', but the stanza contains a non-empty translation_loss list detailing specific grammatical and idiomatic losses. This is internally inconsistent.

original_poem:
यहाँ से शहर को देखो  
कितना बदला है शहर,  
वो रास्ते जिन पर चलते-चलते  
थक कर तुमने कहा था - "अब बस!"
translated_poem:
Look at the city from here  
How much the city has changed,  
Those streets on which, walking on and on,  
You tiredly said - "Enough now!"
